properties.description: Nine real-binary tests (isolated HOME, a deadline per run): a pointer folder × every store-opening mode × read/write/no-design/design-making tools (exit 1, the design's id and address named, the folder unchanged); a store left beside a pointer; an empty folder, read versus write; an opted-in folder; --only-if-present; --read-only with a graph write, a file write (new, and existing with overwrite) and reads; --export-to and --remote with --call; and every flag --help lists × all thirteen one-shot modes (--describe and --list-tools added 2026-10-03, item 7c), each honoured or refused by name with the folder left empty.
properties.findings: OBSERVED FAILING FIRST on main 9ecb405 (the fold d9e2a8f changed no code): 8 of 9 failed, each on exit 0 where a refusal was expected; the walk reported 529 failing flag × mode combinations. The ninth (an opted-in folder reads as its empty design) passes on main by design: it guards the installer's minting export against this fix. On the branch: 9 of 9 pass. RE-RUN 2026-10-03 on feat/the-cli-describes-a-tool with the two describe modes' rows added: it failed on main 293f957 (78 combinations, --describe unknown to clap) and passes, 9 of 9.
properties.name: Every one-shot mode resolves its design first, and every flag is honoured or refused
